safetyMessage: Root setup enables advanced guided repair, scope refresh, diagnostics, and rollback. It does not guarantee unsupported private ROM hooks will work on every firmware build.
changelog: Added Root Setup Problem Solver section to the toolbox.
Added guided root setup plan for Magisk, KernelSU, APatch, and compatible managers.
Added Fix current matters checklist for module, scope, reboot, and tweak isolation issues.
Added Optimize and refresh workflow for broken tweaks after ROM updates.
Added full solver report export with root, LSPosed, scope, ROM, and feature state details.
Updated localization strings for the new problem solver actions.
